goal_title: Fix pedagogical ordering issues flagged by audits
why: Four sequences have map-order bugs where the JSON ordering contradicts the intended concept flow. These are low-effort / high-impact fixes.
success_criteria: swarmintelligence: Physarum moved later in sequence
Each fix documented with reasoning in commit message

tasks.title: wavefunctions: swap Sine_Space and Unit_Circle
tasks.spec: In commons/maps/sequences/wavefunctions.json, move WaveFunctions_Unit_Circle before WaveFunctions_Sine_Space in the maps[] array. Per doc/curriculum_audit/wavefunctions.md, Unit_Circle is the conceptual keystone and should precede spatialization. Update artifact_groups order if needed.

tasks.title: array_tutorial: dimension ladder before patterns
tasks.spec: Edit commons/maps/sequences/array_tutorial.json. Reorder sequences.array_tutorial.maps from the current order [Tutorial_Pattern, Array_Patterns, Tutorial_Single, Tutorial_Row, Tutorial_2D_Build, Tutorial_3D, Tutorial_Disco, Chamber_Arrays] to [Tutorial_Single, Tutorial_Row, Tutorial_2D_Build, Tutorial_3D, Tutorial_Pattern, Array_Patterns, Tutorial_Disco, Chamber_Arrays]. This matches the audit in doc/curriculum_audit/array_tutorial.md: teach the dimension ladder first, then array-as-function and pattern maps, then room-scale synthesis.

tasks.title: cellularautomata: GameOfLife before ElementaryRules
tasks.spec: Edit commons/maps/sequences/cellularautomata.json. Reorder sequences.cellularautomata.maps from [CA_Introduction, CA_ElementaryRules, CA_GameOfLife, CA_BeyondBinary, CA_ExpandingSpace, CA_SoftRules, CA_AgentsCircuits, CA_EdgeOfChaos, Chamber_CA] to [CA_Introduction, CA_GameOfLife, CA_ElementaryRules, CA_BeyondBinary, CA_ExpandingSpace, CA_SoftRules, CA_EdgeOfChaos, CA_AgentsCircuits, Chamber_CA]. The audit in doc/curriculum_audit/cellularautomata.md frames the concept flow as substrate -> canonical 2D Life -> 1D systematization -> generalization -> classification -> computation.

tasks.title: swarmintelligence: move Physarum later
tasks.spec: Edit commons/maps/sequences/swarmintelligence.json. Reorder sequences.swarmintelligence.maps from [SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony, SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields, SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm, SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_ABM, SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimization, SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimization, SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Algorithms, Chamber_Swarm] to [SwarmIntelligence_FlowFields, SwarmIntelligence_Boids_Algorithm, SwarmIntelligence_Agent_Based_Modeling_ABM, SwarmIntelligence_Ant_Colony_Optimization, SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimization, SwarmIntelligence_PhysarumColony, SwarmIntelligence_Swarm_Intelligence_Algorithms, Chamber_Swarm]. The audit in doc/curriculum_audit/swarmintelligence.md argues Physarum should land as the radical late boundary case, not as the opener.

tasks.title: Fix Point_Lines structure row 27 unreachable platforms
tasks.spec: Discovery is complete: commons/maps/Point_Lines/map_data.json currently passes python tools/map_pathfinder.py check Point_Lines, but python tools/map_pathfinder.py show Point_Lines still reports one unreachable artifact: dgrid at (6,26) on void row 26. Decide which of two outcomes is correct: (a) add reachable floor or bridge structure so the late-map dgrid island is intentionally visitable, or (b) keep it display-only and document or mark that choice so future audits stop treating it as a latent bug.
tasks.verification: python tools/map_pathfinder.py check Point_Lines && python tools/map_pathfinder.py show Point_Lines
